title: Imperative grammar sheet and role play card
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 37 (Imperative grammar sheet and role play card (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 37: Directions in the exam: role play and the imperative explained. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

parts.text: Cannot start with sukun: add hamzat al-wasl: اِذْهَبْ

panels.title: 'Do not': لَا النَّاهِيَة
points: لَا + jussive: لَا تَذْهَبْ (do not go)
لَا تَتَأَخَّرُوا (do not be late, to a group)

panels.title: Role play (Group B, 1AA0 style)
points: You are a tourist. Ask: the way to the museum
Respond to the unexpected question (!) and say thank you

keywords.def: fixed by dropping the nun (e.g. اِذْهَبُوا)
the joining alif at the start of اِذْهَبْ

questions.q: Form the imperative (to a man) of تَجْلِسُ.
Say 'do not cross the road' (تَعْبُرُ) to a man.
Core: Exam-style grammar (portal quiz): form the imperative to a man and a woman of تَدْخُلُ، تَفْتَحُ، تَقْرَأُ، تَمْشِي.
questions.a: اُدْخُلْ / اُدْخُلِي؛ اِفْتَحْ / اِفْتَحِي؛ اِقْرَأْ / اِقْرَئِي؛ اِمْشِ / اِمْشِي

questions.q: Extend (Group B): perform the role play in a breakout pair, then swap roles; record (audio only) for teacher feedback.
questions.a: Role play with all bullet points covered and the unexpected question answered

questions.q: Stretch (Group A): give the full i'rab of اِقْرَأْ in اِقْرَأِ النَّصَّ.
questions.a: فِعْلُ أَمْرٍ مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى السُّكُونِ، وَحُرِّكَ بِالكَسْرِ لِالْتِقَاءِ السَّاكِنَيْنِ؛ وَالفَاعِلُ ضَمِيرٌ مُسْتَتِرٌ تَقْدِيرُهُ أَنْتَ
B) اُكْتُبْ. The middle vowel of يَكْتُبُ is dammah, so the joining alif takes dammah: اُكْتُبْ.

questions.q: The imperative is always: A) مَبْنِيّ B) مُعْرَب
Big question: how is the imperative formed?
questions.a: From the jussive 'you' present: drop the تَـ and add a joining alif if the word starts with sukun.
